summary: Discover effective strategies in social protection and food security through our expert-led training. Equip yourself to tackle global challenges now!
lede: Food security programming connects social assistance with household vulnerability, benefit delivery, and nutrition outcomes. For professionals working with programme delivery, beneficiary data, assessments, or reporting, this course develops practical skills in vulnerability assessment, designing cash, voucher, or in-kind delivery approaches, and monitoring food security results. Participants also practice creating targeting matrices, beneficiary flow diagrams, and monitoring scorecards to support programme decisions and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with programme delivery, beneficiary data, assessments, or reporting and need a sharper method for connecting social protection with food security outcomes.
modules: Social Protection and Food Security Linkages
prerequisites: You should have a basic understanding of social protection, food security, or programme M&E concepts. A laptop is recommended for working through templates and monitoring exercises, and participants should bring examples of current workflows, indicator lists, or reporting formats where available.
